tools.name: get_account
tools.title: Get my dealer account
tools.description: Return the signed-in dealer's profile, approval status, subscription tier and current wallet balance.

tools.name: list_available_leads
tools.title: List available leads
tools.description: Browse leads currently available in the marketplace. Contact details stay hidden until a lead is purchased. Supports filtering by province, city, quality grade and price range.

quality_grade.description: Filter by grade, e.g. A+, A, B+.

max_price.description: Only leads at or below this price.

limit.description: Maximum number of leads to return (default 20, max 100).

tools.name: list_my_purchases
tools.title: List my purchased leads
tools.description: List leads the signed-in dealer has purchased, including the price paid, delivery status and the full lead details.

limit.description: Maximum number of purchases to return (default 20, max 100).

tools.name: list_wallet_transactions
tools.title: List wallet transactions
tools.description: List the signed-in dealer's wallet activity (top-ups, lead purchases, refunds) with the running balance, plus the current balance.

limit.description: Maximum number of transactions to return (default 25, max 100).
